ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point C is a point on line segment AB, point D is the midpoint of line segment BC, and $AB=16\,cm$, $CD=3\,cm$. Find the length of line segment AC.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point D is the midpoint of line segment BC, and $CD=3\,\text{cm}$,\\
it follows that $BC=2CD=6\,\text{cm}$,\\
therefore, $AC=AB-BC=16-6=\boxed{10}\,\text{cm}$.
